Mod.Name: Hedgehog Skip Pack
Mod.Author: CheddarBung
Mod.Description:
Quality-of-life skip pack for repeat playthroughs of Final Fantasy IX. Enable only the skips you want.
Pandemonium Bridge Skip Skips the Pandemonium Light bridge sequence So lights dont trigger random encounters.
Sword Fight Skip The Swordfight always gives 100% impressed so you get the 10000 gill and the moonstone form Queen Brahne.
Hedgehog Skip Removes Hedgehog pie detction so you cant be caught stealing the key in Desert Palace.
Sand Skip Disables the Cleyra Trunk sand-trap button-mashing sequence.
